actions.name: ephemeral
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't wear or carry anything.

actions.name: illumination
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet.

actions.name: incorporeal movement
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can move through other creatures and objects as if they were &Reference[Difficult Terrain]. It takes [[/damage 1d10 average type=force]] damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: vanish
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} and its light have the &Reference[Invisible apply=false] condition until the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s &Reference[Concentration] ends on this effect, which ends early immediately after the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes an attack roll or uses Consume Life.

actions.name: consume life
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=1Hy8CdhpwQlLxDPq]], [[lookup @target.affects.special activity=1Hy8CdhpwQlLxDPq]] the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=1Hy8CdhpwQlLxDPq]] feet. that has 0 Hit Points. Failure: The target dies, and the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} regains [[/healing average activity=1waYTjY3NAIGZgrI]].
